name: Season of Weaving
oracle_text:
Choose up to five {P} worth of modes. You may choose the same mode more than once.
{P} — Draw a card.
{P}{P} — Choose an artifact or creature you control. Create a token that's a copy of it.
{P}{P}{P} — Return each nonland, nontoken permanent to its owner's hand.
blocked_sentences: Choose up to five {P} worth of modes. You may choose the same mode more than once.

needs.what: A weighted, repeatable mode selection on `choose_mode`: each mode carries a per-mode cost (its paw-symbol worth, e.g. 1 / 2 / 3), the whole choice carries a total budget the sum of the chosen modes' costs must stay within (5 here, 'up to' so spending less is legal), and the same mode may be chosen more than once, resolving once per selection. Concretely: a per-mode weight key alongside `modes`, plus a budget key alongside `count`/`up_to`, plus explicit permission to repeat a mode (the inverse of `once_each`).
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `choose_mode`'s `op_options` are `chooser`, `count`, `modes`, `once_each`, `or_more`, `up_to`, `up_to_if` — every one of them counts *modes chosen*, and none can attach a cost to a mode or a ceiling to the sum. The nearest miss, `{"up_to": true, "count": 5}`, would let a player take the three-paw bounce mode five times (and combine it freely with five one-paw draws), which is wildly stronger than the printed card, where three paws of bounce leaves only two paws to spend. Going the other way, `count: 5` with `once_each` forbids the repeats the card explicitly grants and still ignores the weights. There is no value or condition in `value_keys`/`condition_keys` that can be read against the running total of a mode selection either, so the budget cannot be enforced from inside the modes.

notes: Only the budget line is blocked — all three individual modes are already expressible today, so the follow-up card work is cheap once `mode-budget` lands.

{P}{P} — Choose an artifact or creature you control. Create a token that's a copy of it. => `copy_permanent` (which carries `objects`, `amount`, `controller`, `tapped`) over {"zone": "battlefield", "controller": "you", "any_types": ["Artifact", "Creature"], "count": 1}.

{P}{P}{P} — Return each nonland, nontoken permanent to its owner's hand. => {"op": "return_to_hand", "objects": {"zone": "battlefield", "not_types": ["Land"], "is_token": false, "count": "all"}} — `not_types`, `is_token` and `count` are all in `selector_keys`.
The mode weights are 1, 2 and 3 paws respectively and the total is 5, chosen as 'up to', with repeats permitted.
